assumptions: Each gene's RBS is designed in the context the preceding gene leaves, which is why it differs from the same design in isolation.
limits: Reports each gene's achieved relative strength, not expression levels or polar effects.
Transcriptional terminators and internal promoters are not placed or avoided here.
bio.jane/contract.question: What does an operon of these CDSs look like with a fresh RBS in front of each, designed against its real upstream context?

description: Stack several CDSs into one contiguous operon, designing a fresh ribosome-binding site in front of each one AGAINST ITS REAL UPSTREAM CONTEXT — which is why the RBS for gene 2 is not the RBS design_rbs would give it in isolation. Returns the assembled sequence, its layout, and each gene's achieved strength.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

cds.description: the coding sequences to stack, in order — wire upstream `record` outputs here, or name library documents.

include_subject.description: put the node's subject first, as the first gene.

leader.description: leader placed before the FIRST ribosome-binding site (defaults to the design leader). Advanced.

promoter.description: promoter sequence to place in front of the operon (optional). Advanced.

target_strength.description: relative initiation strength to aim for at every gene, on the model's own scale — 1 is as strong as its reference site. Overridden per gene by `target_strengths`.

target_strengths.description: per-gene target strengths, aligned to `cds` — the Operon panel gives every row its own, and a run through this door could not say the same thing. Shorter than `cds` falls back to `target_strength` for the rest. Advanced.

terminator.description: terminator sequence to place after the last gene (optional). Advanced.

name: assemble_operon

genes.description: per gene: the RBS designed for it, its spacing, the strength achieved and whether it hit the target

layout.description: every element in order — promoter, each RBS, each CDS, terminator — with its start and end

onTarget.description: true when EVERY gene reached its target strength — the number to check before ordering

record.description: the assembled operon as a record
